premise.logline: A touring actor who has played the same villain for eleven years is told she will be replaced by the understudy she trained.

modules.theme: what is left of someone who has only ever been one part
modules.setting_time: the final three weeks of a long regional tour
modules.setting_place: a string of half-empty provincial theatres
modules.protagonist: a lead actor who has never missed a performance
modules.protagonist_want: to make the company regret the decision before closing night
modules.antagonism: a producer who thinks loyalty is a cost
modules.complication: the understudy is better than she was, and kinder
modules.ending_shape: she lets go of the part and keeps something truer
